AdminPasswordResetSent.description: POST /platform/companies/{id}/admins/{user_id}/password-reset: the reset link went to this address.
AdminPasswordResetSent.title: AdminPasswordResetSent

AuditLog.description:
Build with `from_row`, not `model_validate(row)`: the ORM attribute is `meta` (`metadata` is
SQLAlchemy's MetaData on declarative classes), `ip_address` is an `ipaddress` object, and `actor`
comes from a join the caller performs.
AuditLog.title: AuditLog

AuditLogQuery.description: GET /audit-logs (administrators): newest first by `seq`; dates are company-local.
AuditLogQuery.title: AuditLogQuery

BrandImageQuery.description:
GET /public/companies/{slug}/brand/{kind}.png: `v` is the image's version, as the addresses of a
`CompanyBrand` carry it. It selects nothing (the image is always the current one): it only decides
how long the answer may be kept.
BrandImageQuery.title: BrandImageQuery

BrandPalette.description:
The shades derived from a company's colour (`app.core.palette`), each `#rrggbb`. Text and its
background are always one of these pairs: `on_surface` on `surface` or `surface_hover`; white
(`on_strong`) on `strong`, `strong_hover` or `deep`; `on_bright` on `bright`; `bright` on `deep`;
`strong` on white or on `tint`.

`surface` is what the brand's surfaces are painted with (the application's shell, primary buttons):
the chosen colour itself wherever white or the dark ink reads on it, otherwise `strong`. `strong`
is the colour of text, links and icons on white (B12-21).
BrandPalette.title: BrandPalette

BrandPaletteRequest.description: POST /platform/brand/palette: the palette a colour would give (nothing is saved).
BrandPaletteRequest.title: BrandPaletteRequest

BuildingUpdate.description:
PATCH: omitted fields are unchanged; `name_ar` null (or blank) clears it; `is_active` archives
(false) or restores (true).
BuildingUpdate.title: BuildingUpdate

CompanyAdminCreate.description:
A company administrator created by the platform owner: a SYSTEM_ADMIN who must change the
temporary password at the first sign-in (72 hours, D-11), like POST /users.
CompanyAdminCreate.title: CompanyAdminCreate

CompanyBrand.description:
A company's identity. The three addresses are same-origin paths of the public image endpoint,
each carrying the version of its image (use them as they are); null where the company has no such
image. `palette` is null exactly when `color` is. `version` changes whenever an image or the colour
changes.
CompanyBrand.title: CompanyBrand

CompanyBrandUpdate.description: PATCH /platform/companies/{id}/brand: the company's colour, or null for the product's palette.
CompanyBrandUpdate.title: CompanyBrandUpdate

CompanyCounts.description: What the platform owner may know about a company's use (B11-2).
CompanyCounts.title: CompanyCounts

CompanySettingsUpdate.description:
PATCH: omitted fields are unchanged; `name_ar`, `address`, `address_ar` and `email_domain` may be
null (or blank) to clear them. `name_ar` follows the rules of `name` (trimmed, 1-200 characters, one
line, no control or text-direction characters), `address_ar` those of `address`.
CompanySettingsUpdate.title: CompanySettingsUpdate

DepartmentCount.description:
`name` and `name_ar` are the department's current names (B10-25); a visit without a department
counts under `department_id` null, "No department" and no Arabic name.
DepartmentCount.title: DepartmentCount

DepartmentRef.description:
A department as other resources embed it. `name` is the default (English, or only) name and
`name_ar` the Arabic one, null when it has none: an Arabic interface shows `name_ar` when it is set,
else `name` (B10-25). In a visit both are the snapshots recorded on the visit (D-17).
DepartmentRef.title: DepartmentRef

DepartmentUpdate.description: PATCH: omitted fields are unchanged; `name_ar` may be null (or blank) to clear it.
DepartmentUpdate.title: DepartmentUpdate

EditableEmailKind.description:
The e-mails whose texts a company may change (B11-20; the host's three of a scheduled visit since
Phase 14, B14-2); the security e-mails may not (B11-21).
EditableEmailKind.title: EditableEmailKind

EmailPreview.description:
The e-mail rendered with sample data (B11-28): the subject, the HTML document with its images as
`data:` URIs (show it in a sandboxed frame) and the plain-text part.
EmailPreview.title: EmailPreview

EmailPreviewDocumentQuery.description:
GET /email-templates/{kind}/preview: the language that leads the previewed e-mail, and the design
the document shows (B13-5).
EmailPreviewDocumentQuery.title: EmailPreviewDocumentQuery

EmailScheme.description:
Which design of an e-mail a preview shows (Phase 13, B13-5): `light` or `dark`, alone, as a mail
client in that scheme shows it, whatever the colour scheme of the device the preview is seen on.
EmailScheme.title: EmailScheme

EmailTemplateField.description: One editable text: its limits, the product's text and the company's (null: the product's).
EmailTemplateField.title: EmailTemplateField

EmailTemplatePreviewRequest.description:
POST /email-templates/{kind}/preview and /test: `language` leads the e-mail; `ar` / `en` are unsaved
texts (a draft) applied over the saved ones, with the rules of PATCH. `scheme` is the design a preview
shows (B13-5); a test e-mail is the e-mail as it is sent, with both designs, whatever it says.
EmailTemplatePreviewRequest.title: EmailTemplatePreviewRequest

EmailTemplateReset.description: POST /email-templates/{kind}/reset: one language, or both when `language` is omitted or null.
EmailTemplateReset.title: EmailTemplateReset

EmailTemplateTexts.description:
Texts of one language. A field that is left out is unchanged; null or blank text returns it to the
product's text. Plain text only (B11-24): `{variable}` placeholders, and line breaks in multi-line
fields.
EmailTemplateTexts.title: EmailTemplateTexts

EmailTemplateUpdate.description: PATCH /email-templates/{kind}: field errors are reported at `ar.<field>` / `en.<field>`.
EmailTemplateUpdate.title: EmailTemplateUpdate

EmailTestSent.description: POST /email-templates/{kind}/test: the test e-mail went to the caller's own address.
EmailTestSent.title: EmailTestSent

EnrollBlocker.description: Why a visit cannot be enrolled now: a short state the interface shows instead of a note.
EnrollBlocker.title: EnrollBlocker

HostSearchQuery.description: GET /users/hosts: matches the host's name only (B1-38).
HostSearchQuery.title: HostSearchQuery

InsideVisit.description: `Visit` on the evacuation list (B57-72); only `visitor` differs.
InsideVisit.title: InsideVisit

InsideVisitor.description:
The visitor of an evacuation-list entry: the visit's snapshot (D-17) plus the visitor record's
current phone, like `host.phone` (B57-72), so staff at the assembly point can call a missing
visitor.
InsideVisitor.title: InsideVisitor

JourneyEventType.description: What a stored journey event is (the provider's ENROLLMENT_FAILED and HEARTBEAT are not stored).
JourneyEventType.title: JourneyEventType

JourneyListQuery.description: GET /journeys: the visits that were inside during the company-local `day` (default today).
JourneyListQuery.title: JourneyListQuery

JourneyLocation.description: A zone with its floor and building: where a camera is, or was when an event arrived.
JourneyLocation.title: JourneyLocation

Language.description: A user's interface and e-mail language (Phase 10, B10-1). Arabic is the product's default.
Language.title: Language

LocationTree.description:
GET /locations: every building of the company, active and archived, by name; floors by level;
zones by name.
LocationTree.title: LocationTree

ObservationMatch.description: The provider's own judgement of an observation.
ObservationMatch.title: ObservationMatch

PlatformAuditLogQuery.description: GET /platform/audit-logs: newest first; `company_id` keeps the rows about that company.
PlatformAuditLogQuery.title: PlatformAuditLogQuery

PlatformCompanyAdmin.description: One of a company's administrators (SYSTEM_ADMIN), the only users the platform owner sees.
PlatformCompanyAdmin.title: PlatformCompanyAdmin

PlatformCompanyCreated.description: POST /platform/companies: the company and its first administrator.
PlatformCompanyCreated.title: PlatformCompanyCreated

PlatformCompanyListQuery.description: GET /platform/companies: `q` matches the name, the Arabic name or the slug.
PlatformCompanyListQuery.title: PlatformCompanyListQuery

PlatformCompanyUpdate.description:
PATCH: the company's identity. Omitted fields are unchanged; `name_ar` may be null (or blank) to
clear it. The slug never changes (B11-12).
PlatformCompanyUpdate.title: PlatformCompanyUpdate

PlatformMe.description: GET /platform/auth/me: who is signed in to the platform (401 when nobody is).
PlatformMe.title: PlatformMe

PlatformTrackingUpdate.description:
PATCH /platform/companies/{id}/tracking. Turning it off also switches the company's tracking off
and ends its open tracking associations.
PlatformTrackingUpdate.title: PlatformTrackingUpdate

PreferencesUpdate.description: PATCH /auth/preferences: the caller's interface and e-mail language (B10-3).
PreferencesUpdate.title: PreferencesUpdate

ProviderOperation.description: A call of the application to the provider that failed (counted in the health record).
ProviderOperation.title: ProviderOperation

PublicCompanyBrand.description:
GET /public/companies/{slug}/brand: what a sign-in page and a visitor's pass page may know of an
active company before anyone signs in: how it is named, its language and its identity.
PublicCompanyBrand.title: PublicCompanyBrand

QrCheckIn.description: `pass_token` as scanned or pasted, like `ScanRequest.token`: an invalid pass is 404 PASS_INVALID.
QrCheckIn.title: QrCheckIn

QrCheckOut.description: `pass_token` as scanned or pasted, like `ScanRequest.token`: an invalid pass is 404 PASS_INVALID.
QrCheckOut.title: QrCheckOut

RejectReason.description: Why an event was rejected. Rejected events are never stored, only counted (B15-9, B15-11).
RejectReason.title: RejectReason

ReportSummaryQuery.description:
GET /reports/summary: company-local dates, inclusive. The service fills an open end (default: the
last REPORT_DEFAULT_DAYS days) and applies the same REPORT_MAX_DAYS limit to the result.
ReportSummaryQuery.title: ReportSummaryQuery

ScanErrorDetails.description: `error.details` of the scan error responses in contract §6 rows 2-8.
ScanErrorDetails.title: ScanErrorDetails

ScanRequest.description:
A pass URL or a bare token exactly as scanned or pasted; input that is not a valid pass is
answered 404 PASS_INVALID (contract §6), not 422.
ScanRequest.title: ScanRequest

TemplateField.description: An editable text of an e-mail (B11-20). Which kind has which is `app.email.editable.EDITABLE`.
TemplateField.title: TemplateField

TrackingAssociation.description: A visit's tracking association. Its reference is the provider's and is never answered (B15-6).
TrackingAssociation.title: TrackingAssociation

TrackingAssociationStatus.description:
A visit's tracking association: PENDING until the provider confirms the enrollment (ENROLLED),
ACTIVE until it ends; an ENDED association never becomes active again.
TrackingAssociationStatus.title: TrackingAssociationStatus

TrackingCameraUpdate.description: PATCH: omitted fields are unchanged; `is_active` archives (false) or restores (true).
TrackingCameraUpdate.title: TrackingCameraUpdate

TrackingHealth.description: Reasons and counts only, never an event's content (B15-11).
TrackingHealth.title: TrackingHealth

TrackingKeyCreated.description: POST /tracking/keys: the only answer that carries the key. It is stored as a SHA-256 digest.
TrackingKeyCreated.title: TrackingKeyCreated

TrackingSettingsUpdate.description: PATCH /tracking/settings: omitted fields are unchanged; `min_confidence` null clears it.
TrackingSettingsUpdate.title: TrackingSettingsUpdate

TrackingStatus.description: GET /tracking/status: one line for the Visitor Journey page's banner.
TrackingStatus.title: TrackingStatus

UserListQuery.description:
GET /users (administrators): `q` matches name or e-mail; `role` keeps users holding any of the
given roles.
UserListQuery.title: UserListQuery

UserUpdate.description: PATCH: omitted fields are unchanged; `phone`/`department_id` may be set to null to clear them.
UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate

VisitHost.description: `full_name` is the snapshot; `phone` is the host's current phone (D-26).
VisitHost.title: VisitHost

VisitInvitation.description:
Latest VISITOR_INVITATION e-mail of the visit, or the failure of the calendar invitation that
followed it (Phase 14, B14-18).
VisitInvitation.title: VisitInvitation

VisitListQuery.description:
GET /visits. Filters narrow the caller's scope and never widen it: for EMPLOYEE-only callers
`scope` is always `mine` and `host_id` is intersected with their own visits (§7.5). `date_from` /
`date_to` are company-local dates of `scheduled_start`; `scope` and `order` default per view in the
service.
VisitListQuery.title: VisitListQuery

VisitNotice.description:
Latest VISIT_CANCELLED / VISIT_RESCHEDULED e-mail to the visitor (B57-03): whether the visitor was
told about the change, and if not, why. `error` is set while the notice is not SENT.
VisitNotice.title: VisitNotice

VisitPassResult.description: POST /visits/{id}/pass (B57-04): a new pass for the host to share; the previous one stops working.
VisitPassResult.title: VisitPassResult

VisitResendResult.description:
POST /visits/{id}/invitation: the visit, and the new pass's one-time URL; null when only the
calendar invitation was sent again (it alone had failed, `VisitInvitation.calendar_failed`, B14-31),
and the pass the visitor has stays valid.
VisitResendResult.title: VisitResendResult

VisitUpdate.description: PATCH while SCHEDULED: omitted fields are unchanged; `department_id` may be null to clear it.
VisitUpdate.title: VisitUpdate

VisitVisitor.description: Snapshot of the visitor at creation/check-in (D-17).
VisitVisitor.title: VisitVisitor

VisitorInput.description: Inline visitor for visit creation / walk-ins (deduplicated by e-mail within the company).
VisitorInput.title: VisitorInput

VisitorSearchQuery.description: GET /visitors: normalised search over name, e-mail and company, plus phone digits (§4).
VisitorSearchQuery.title: VisitorSearchQuery

VisitorStats.description: Computed within the caller's visibility scope.
VisitorStats.title: VisitorStats

VisitorUpdate.description: PATCH: omitted fields are unchanged; email/phone/company_name may be null to clear them.
VisitorUpdate.title: VisitorUpdate
